title: NBA Official Injury Report - consecutive editions, 11/15/26 06:00 AM ET and 06:15 AM ET
how_read: the official hub page lists every edition published on 11/15; the two newest (06:00 AM and 06:15 AM ET) were both read in full and transcribed row by row. Every 11/15 status row that both editions print is identical in both - the two copies above are therefore transcribed from the same read and the difference between them is stated explicitly in edition_comparison rather than being asserted. Where the 06:00 render of the PDF dropped a row's Team cell at a page break, that row is kept unattributed in that edition and attributed in the edition that prints the cell: the difference is the finding.
limitations: The 06:15 AM PDF's text layer was returned in two chunks by the fetch channel and one row (Sorber) is split across the boundary; the tail was re-joined from the continuation chunk, which is recorded in that row's team_basis note.

The PDF bytes themselves were not downloaded in this sandbox (the sandbox cannot reach ak-static); the transcription is of the official PDF's rendered text, and no binary sha256 is claimed for this capture. The scheduled job on the GitHub runner does store the raw bytes with their own hash (data/raw/_capture_injury_pdf_<edition>.json).

Rows for 11/16 print NOT YET SUBMITTED for all 16 clubs at 06:15 AM ET: the day-before deadline (5 PM local on 11/15) has not passed. Blank here means 'the league has not been given the filing yet', not 'no injuries'.

edition_comparison.status_changes: none. Both editions print the same status for every player that appears in both; the 15-minute gap moved nothing, which is reported as a finding rather than presented as a broken diff.

structural_differences.why_it_matters: a status attached to no team cannot be priced. The later edition resolves it; the earlier one is kept as printed rather than back-filled from the later one.
